AboutMe.Title: About Me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: In {{years}} years of experience I have covered many roles: Backend Developer, Frontend Developer, and Database. I love contributing my knowledge to create new things that help solve problems.
My capabilities also include implementing system improvements, optimizing sites, standardizing patterns, and suggesting and executing ideas that add value to the project I am working on.
I also program things for my personal use, whether for hobby or utility.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Demand And Assessement
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: The Demand and Assessment Survey System is an interactive web-based application designed to collect survey responses from citizens using a user-friendly interface integrated with Google Maps. The system enables government agencies, municipalities, or private organizations to conduct large-scale surveys, gather insights, and make data-driven decisions.This platform allows citizens to answer predefined survey questions related to infrastructure development, public services, social initiatives, or community projects. Based on their responses, authorities can analyze demand trends and prioritize initiatives accordingly.

OtherProjects.Title: More Projects

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: HRMS Portal For Organization
OtherProjects.Projects.Summary: Role-based HR portal for employees, geofenced attendance, leave and announcements.
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: A single system of record for an organization's people operations: who works there, where they are supposed to be, when they were in, and how much leave they have left. It replaces spreadsheets and approval emails with one login that adapts to each user's role.
Highlights: Five roles (Super Admin, HR Manager, Management, Dept Manager, Employee) with permission-driven menus and screens
Employee directory with auto-generated employee codes, org chart and self-service profile
GPS punch in/out validated against geofenced offices, client sites or Work-From-Home/Field assignments
Attendance regularization and leave approvals routed to the reporting manager, with company-wide fallback approvers
Leave types with annual allocation, carry-forward limits and real-time available/pending balances
Announcements with priority, publish/expiry dates, attachments and an unread notification badge
Organization masters (company, branch, department, designation), user/role management and audit logs

OtherProjects.Projects.Summary: AI text summarizer built with Spring AI, Groq and Ollama.
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: A full-stack AI text summarizer: paste in long text and get a concise summary generated by a large language model. The Spring Boot backend uses Spring AI to call models through the Groq API and Ollama, with an Angular frontend and a PostgreSQL database.

Spring AI integration with Groq API and Ollama models
Spring Boot REST backend with PostgreSQL hosted on Neon
Angular frontend deployed on Vercel, backend deployed on Render
